setting_rationale.max_age_seconds: One bounded five-second development hypothesis; not calibrated.
setting_rationale.min_similarity: One stricter-than-current-cross-camera appearance gate; not a confidence probability.
setting_rationale.min_margin: Explicit ambiguity rejection margin; no threshold sweep.
setting_rationale.max_speed: Zero expansion: avoid assuming a physical walking speed or meter scale.
setting_rationale.position_slack: Reuse the frozen two-native-unit spatial tolerance as a conservative return radius.
setting_rationale.max_identities: Bounded archive resource budget, not an estimate of the number of people.
